description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing coupon operations in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles displaying the coupon form, saving a coupon, and removing a coupon from the session, integrating with OpenCart's configuration, language, URL, session, model, and response systems.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for handling coupon-related actions in the checkout process, including displaying, saving, and removing coupons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the coupon input form if coupon functionality is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the coupon submitted via POST request into the session if valid and coupons are enabled.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current coupon from the session and clears related session data.
